text:
Maria V: FYI getting multiple customer escalations — /v1/generate p99 spiked from ~180ms -> ~1.8s in eu-west-1 since 22:12 UTC. Support ticket CUST-3245 referencing timeouts and slow TTFB.
AJ: seeing the same in SLO alerts. Grafana shows p95 ~350ms, p99 ~1.8s starting 22:11 UTC. No deploys scheduled around that time?
infra-bot: alert: edge-egress-p99 spike detected in eu-west-1 22:11:23 -> 22:28:00. Affected anycast POP: eu-west-1a.
Kevin L: ran traceroute from active probe, intermittent cross-AZ hairpin - paste below.
```
traceroute to api.redwood.example (35.123.45.67), 30 hops max, 60 byte packets
 1  10.0.0.1  0.320 ms 0.210 ms 0.190 ms
 2  54.123.45.6  5.8 ms 6.0 ms 5.9 ms
 6  * * *
 7  192.0.2.10  1200 ms 1198 ms 1201 ms  <-- large cross-az hop
```
Maria V: that ~1.2s jump maps to the TLS handshake tail in request traces.
AJ: any SNI mismatch / TLS failure logs? Could be route taking long detour.
Kevin L: tcpdump on edge host shows SYN->SYN-ACK RTT ~= 1.15s for affected flows. No TLS errors in server logs.
Maria V: Support wants an immediate mitigation path. Options: fail CUST-3245 traffic to us-east fallback, or pin them to a dedicated pool. Thoughts?
AJ: short-term: override route for the specific customer IP ranges -> us-east fallback. Mid-term: investigate anycast/BGP imbalance with network team.
Kevin L: I'll prepare a route preference canary to lower preference for eu-west-1a and spin up a dedicated fallback pool for the customer. Opening a quick change now.
support-bot: created incident INC-20260317-01 and linked to ticket CUST-3245; on-call paged.
infra-bot: initiating canary route update to reduce preference for eu-west-1a for selected selectors. ETA ~5m.
Maria V: thanks. @Kevin L can you paste the exact canary command so we can audit?
Kevin L: 
```
# canary route change (internal infra API)
curl -X POST https://infra-api.internal/routes/apply -d '{"pop":"eu-west-1a","preference_delta":-200,"selector":"asn:64496"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDACTED'
```
AJ: watching p99 and TLS handshake histogram. If p99 drops for canary subset in 10m we promote; otherwise rollback.
Kevin L: canary applied — confirmed on infra-api.
Maria V: early signal looks good: p99 for canary subset dropped to ~210ms. Support updated customer on interim mitigation.
AJ: leaving monitors and opening follow-up ticket for network team to tune BGP anycast weights and examine peering.
Maria V: great — keeping notes here for postmortem. Will summarize timeline + mitigations after we stabilize. :thumbsup:
